Subject: SI-CP-0007 cold plate — information request for Oscorp (SUP-07)

Hello,

Thank you for your qualification packet for part SI-CP-0007, revision A. To complete our review, please send the following:

1. 2.pfmea — the current process failure-mode analysis (PFMEA) document for this part.
2. 4.cleanliness — the internal cleanliness test report with measured particle counts (particles of 100 µm and larger, and of 500 µm and larger, per part).

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: Review the port bore study (capability_study.md §1.1: Cpk 1.217917313999748, n=50, mean 7.9965 mm, sd 0.0127 mm). Verify raw measurements, and see what process actions are in place to centre and reduce variation.
reliability_report.md §1.2 only states passages meet particle limits. Ask to see the extraction records and particle counts per part against Stark's limits (≤100 at 100 µm, 0 at 500 µm).

capacity.md §1.2 quotes 15 weeks against Stark's 12-week need-by. Walk through the lead-time build-up and check which steps could shorten it, and how this ties to the ramp milestone in capacity.md §1.3.
